periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oriented at an oblique angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis, sloping downward toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval, with the longitudinal axis significantly longer than the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visual downward taper extending toward the lower mandible, shifting the geometric weight below the eye center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary where the black band meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick, spanning approximately one-third of the visible distance between the neck and the tail.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Broad separation between ears, roughly equal to the basal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded top profile.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive brownish-yellow surface staining or soiling across the posterior dorsal and lateral white fur regions.
